title: LLMBar: which of two outputs follows the instruction better?
decision: which of two outputs follows a given instruction better (gold preference label of the data set)

source.name: LLMBar (Evaluating Large Language Models at Evaluating Instruction Following, arXiv:2310.07641)
source.split: no split; all instances of the Natural set and the four Adversarial sets (Natural 100, Neighbor 134, GPTInst 92, GPTOut 47, Manual 46)

licence: MIT License (LICENSE file of the repository)
notes: All 419 instances, no sampling. Gold A 210, B 209 (Natural: 50 / 50; Neighbor: 67 / 67; GPTInst: 46 / 46; GPTOut: 24 / 23; Manual: 23 / 23): the order of the two outputs was drawn anew per row with random.Random(20261007) so that the better one is first in half of the rows of each subset; meta.order names the source fields shown as output A and B, meta.source_label is the label of the file (1 or 2). The files have no ids: meta.source_id is the subset and the 0-based position of the instance in its dataset.json. state.instruction = field `input`. Neighbor, GPTInst, GPTOut and Manual are the Adversarial sets of the repository; the RewardBench card describes their worse outputs as responses to an off-topic prompt (Neighbor; GPTInst: a prompt generated by GPT-4), GPT-4 responses prompted to be unhelpful (GPTOut) and manually designed cases (Manual), so part of the outputs is model-written. Overlap: the same 419 instances, with the same preferred output, form the llmbar-* subsets of the RewardBench filtered split (checked row by row), so rows of the task rewardbench whose meta.subset starts with `llmbar` repeat instances of this task. Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 20 of 419 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 399 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 44 of 399 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 355 items remain.
